terms.comment: Intransitive in our phrases. Ancient usage includes a billowing cloak. Undāre describes the duvet billowing; to make it billow, we move it (moveō, agitō). We do not use transitive strāgulum undō, which would suggest flooding the duvet.

phrases.english: I move the duvet so that it billows.

sources: Lewis & Short: undo, including a billowing cloak
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
